kevaṭṭadāraka: [Kevaṭṭa+dāraka] (pu) CL=7 A young man who is in a fisherman family (lineage). A fisherman child. See - Kevaṭṭagāma.
kevaṭṭagāmavāsī: [Kevaṭṭagāma+vasa+ṇī] (ti) CL=7 One who is living in a fishermen village.
kevaṭṭantevāsī: [Kevaṭṭa+antevāsī] (pu) CL=7 One who is a disciple of a fisherman.
kevaṭṭaputtaka: [Kevaṭṭaputta+ka] (pu) CL=7 A young son of a fisherman.
kevaṭṭasutta:
[Kevaṭṭa+sutta] (na) CL=7 Kevaṭṭasutta. A sutta that preaches +7+10
about when Lord Buddha is dwelling in the Mango Garden of a rich man Pāvārika in Nāḷandha City, preaches to Kevaṭta a rich man"s son who only praises an Anusāsanīpāṭihāriya among three Miracles that are Iddhipāṭihāriya, Ādesanāpāṭihāriya, Anusāsanīpāṭihāriya. Kevaṭṭa Sutta.
keyūra: [Ke+ura] (pu,na) CL=7 [Ka+yā+ūra. Ke sadde, uro, yāgamo. Dhāna,ṭī.287. Ke bāhu sirasi yāti. Thoma.] An ornamental arm band. A ornament decorates on an arm.
keyūravantu: [Keyūra+vantu] (ti) CL=7 One who has an ornamental armband. One who decorates an ornament on his arm.
keḷanā: [Kele+yu+ā] (thī) CL=7 [Nīti,dhā.166. Kīḷa+yu+ā. Dhāna,ṭī.176. Kile+yu+ā. Kile kiḷāyaṃ pemaneca. Nirutti,nhā.366.] (A) Cherish (or) adorns. It is strongly attached to (someone or something). (B) It makes someone cherish or adore it.
keḷi: [Kīḷa+i] (thī) CL=7 [Kīḷa pītiyakīḷanesu, kīḷa vihāreti vā kīḷanaṃ keḷi. Dhāna,ṭī.176.] (A) Making a joke. Mockery (or) ridicule. (B) Playing happily. (Ti) (C) One who is playing happily. See also - Keḷihassasukha. See - Keḷihassasukha.
keḷihassa: [Keḷi+hassa] (pu) CL=7 Laughing (sound) of playing happily child. See - Keḷihassasukha.
keḷihassasukha: [Keḷihassa+sukha] (na) CL=7 It has the pleasure that is laughing (sound) of playing happily child.
keḷihasādhippāya: [Keḷihasa+adhippāya] (ti) CL=7 One who desires to have fun.
keḷinissaya: [Keḷi+nissaya] (ti) CL=7 One who is mocked (by someone).
keḷipurekkhāra: [Keḷi+purekkhāra] (ti) CL=7 One who makes first and foremost playing happily.
keḷisīla: [Keḷi+sīla] (na) CL=7 (1) One who has a habit of fun. (Ti) (2) One who makes a mockery. (B) One who is always playing happily.
keḷisīlaka: [Keḷi+sīla+ka] (ti) CL=7 One who is always playing happily.
keḷāpayituṃ: [Kīḷa+ṇāpaya+tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To fondle. To move from here to there.
keḷāyanta: [Kele+anta] (ti) CL=7 Cherish or adore. Strongly attached to.
keḷāyanti: [Kele+a+anti] (kri) CL=7 They are loving. See - Kelāyati. Keḷāyanti (Kri) [kele+a+anti] They loved (or) cherished. They are strongly attached to it. See - Keḷāyati.
keḷāyanā: [Kele+yu+ā] (thī) CL=7 Cherish (or) Adore. Is strongly attached. See - Keḷanā (A).
keḷāyita: [Kele+ta] (ti) CL=7 One who is worth cherishing.
keṇi: [Kī+nāi.(kreṇi-saṃ)] (thī) CL=7 (1) Purchase (or) Buying. (2) Tax that is paid.
keṇiya: [Keṇi+iya] (pu) CL=7 One who is named Keṇiya.
keṇiyajaṭilavatthu: [Keṇiyajaṭila+vatthu] (na) CL=7 The story of a Hermit Keṇiya. A Hermit Keṇiya who is a Āpaṇa villager in Aṅguttarāpa Country. Who is offered Juice first to Lord Buddha and 1250 Sangha members. Lord Buddha permits 8 kinds of juice for Bhikkhus based on this juice (juice is offered by a Hermit Keṇiya. And then he serves alms and food to Lord Buddha and Sangha.
keṭabhaji: [Keṭabha+ji+kvi] (pu) CL=7 [Keṭabhaṃ jitavā. Thoma. Keṭabhaṃ nāma asuraṃ jinātīti keṭabhaji. Dhāna,ṭī,sya.]  The Hindu deity Vishnu.
keṭubha: [Kiṭa+abha] (na) CL=7 [Kiṭa+ubha+a. Vacanatthato pana kiṭayati gameti ñāpeti kiriyādivibhāganti keṭubhaṃ, kiṭadhātuto abhapaccayavasena akārassa caukāro, atha vā kiriyādivibhāgaṃ anavasesapariyādānato kiṭento gamanto obheti pūretīti keṭubhaṃ, kiṭasaddūpapada ubhadhātuvasena, api ca kiṭanti gacchanti kavayo bandhesu kosallametenāti keṭubhaṃ, purimanayenevetthapadasiddhi. Sī,ṭī,saca,2.22. Vimati,1.27.dī,ṭī,1.291.ma,ṭī,3.166.] (1) Composed poem Treatise. Keṭubha Treatise. Rhetorical composition Treatise. (2) A Treatise that is related to Sutta such is preaching for the subject,etc., Sadda Treatise.
keṭubhavidū: [Keṭubha+vidū] (pu) CL=7 Rhetorical composition skillful person. A composer.
kesarasi: [Kesa+raṃsi] (thī) CL=7 Radiation from hair. The radiation of hair-relic.
keḷāpayitu: [Kīḷa+ṇāpaya+tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To fondle. To move from here to there.
